exposure: maximum diameter of lesions by ultrasound pre-evacuation
outcome: malignant progression to postmolar gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (pGTN)
cohort: The study included 506 patients with pathologically confirmed hydatidiform mole (HM) in Shanghai, China, diagnosed between 2019 and 2023.
finding: Significant risk factors for progression to postmolar gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (pGTN) included pathological type and maximum diameter of lesions by ultrasound pre-evacuation.
